entities.name: Moxen
entities.description: Pieces of jewelry containing gemstones that produce mana; in story, a powerful collection of mana-infused gems owned by Liana of Minorad.

entities.name: Liana of Minorad
entities.description: Owner of the Moxen, who gave them to Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion during her duel with Ravidel.

entities.name: Kristina of the Woods
entities.description: Recipient of the Moxen from Liana, who fought Ravidel.

entities.name: Jared Carthalion
entities.description: Recipient of the Moxen from Liana, who fought Ravidel.

entities.name: Ravidel
entities.description: Dueled Liana at Minorad and claimed the Moxen had once been his; used three Moxen to activate the Mox Beacon.

entities.name: Altair of Coloni
entities.description: Fought Ravidel with Jared and Kristina at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.

entities.name: Caliphear the Nightmare
entities.description: Fought Ravidel with Jared and Kristina at the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor.

entities.name: The Dueling Chasm of Golthonor
entities.description: Site of the battle against Ravidel.

entities.name: Mox Beacon
entities.description: Device Ravidel activated using Mox Jet, Mox Ruby and Mox Sapphire.

entities.name: Mox Jasper
entities.description: A Mox formed on Tarkir after the Dragonstorms imbued the land with dragonfire.

entities.name: Moxite
entities.description: A rare fuel source in the Edge used in nuclear moxite reactors for sub-light travel.

entities.name: Tezzeret
entities.description: Recognized moxite's magical potential, similar to etherium.

events.summary: Liana gives the Moxen to Kristina and Jared during her duel with Ravidel so he will not take them.
events.quote: Liana gave them to Kristina of the Woods and Jared Carthalion during her duel with Ravidel at Minorad so that he would not take them.

events.summary: At the Dueling Chasm of Golthonor, Ravidel uses Mox Jet, Mox Ruby and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon against Jared and his allies.
events.quote: Ravidel used the Mox Jet , Mox Ruby , and Mox Sapphire to activate the Mox Beacon

relations.quote: mana-infused gems owned by Liana of Minorad

relations.note: Ravidel fought Jared, Kristina and their allies
relations.quote: at the battle with Jared, Kristina, Altair of Coloni and Caliphear the Nightmare against Ravidel
